heatcomp_L1.report_head:
# SurroSelect report
256 runs, 4 inputs, 256 outputs. Cross-validated mean relative L2 error (4 folds).

| model | CV error | within tie band of best | seconds |
|---|---:|:---:|---:|
| gp_full[rbf] | 4.062e-03 | yes | 20.2 |
| pod_krr_wide | 4.277e-03 | yes | 0.7 |
| pod_gp[matern52,r=32] | 4.532e-03 | yes | 6.3 |
| gp_full[matern52] | 4.562e-03 | yes | 30.0 |
| pod_poly | 6.687e-03 |  | 0.1 |
| pod_gp[matern52,r=8] | 1.142e-02 |  | 6.4 |
| pod_gp[rbf,r=32] | 1.226e-01 |  | 4.2 |

**Selected:** gp_full[rbf] (CV error 4.06e-03). Models tied with it (within 1.26x): gp_full[rbf], pod_krr_wide, pod_gp[matern52,r=32], gp_full[matern52].

**Basis check.** Best POD-based model: pod_krr_wide (CV error 4.28e-03); error of projecting held-out fields on a 32-mode basis: 3.66e-15. The POD basis is not the limiting factor at this training size.

**Learning curve** (gp_full[rbf]): n=24: 8.07e-02, n=48: 4.12e-02, n=96: 1.37e-02, n=192: 4.06e-03
Extrapolated error with 1024 runs: about 2.5e-04 (range 2.5e-04 to 4.0e-04); extrapolation over 4x the data is a rough guide only.
Runs needed for error 0.01: about 113.
